description: This file defines the SetTokenParser class in Twig, responsible for parsing the 'set' tag which assigns variables in Twig templates. It handles different forms of variable assignment, including simple assignments, multiple targets, and block captures.

classes.name: SetTokenParser
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractTokenParser that parses the 'set' tag in Twig templates, enabling variable assignment and block capturing features.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'set' tag, handling variable assignment and block capture, and returns a SetNode for template compilation.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token corresponds to the end of a 'set' block, i.e., 'endset'.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name 'set' associated with this parser.
